sections.title: hányadika van? — what's the date?
sections.content: To say a date, the ordinal gets one more ending, -a/-e plus -n. It looks like a mouthful but it's built from pieces you already know: első becomes elseje ("its first") and then elsején ("on its first") — "on the 1st". A full date is [month] + [day]-án/-én.

items.english: I have Hungarian class on October 10th.

sections.content: Dates past the 10th follow exactly the same pattern (huszadikán "on the 20th", harmincegyedikén "on the 31st") — you'll pick those up naturally as you meet the bigger numbers they're built from.
